stem: Which statement BEST describes the importance of the Battle of Vicksburg?

options.label: F
options.text: The Confederacy lost control of the Mississippi River.

options.label: G
options.text: It was the opening engagement of the Civil War in the South.

options.label: H
options.text: It was described as the bloodiest fighting of the Civil War.

options.label: J
options.text: The Confederacy captured military supplies from the North.
